requirements.original_requirement: Prepare exact setup/startup instructions, migrations, seed commands, environment template, architecture/data-flow explanation, role matrix, matching explanation, baseline comparison, test evidence, limitations, and team module guide. Provide seeded synthetic credentials without production secrets. Implement an idempotent reset procedure gated to development/demo data; it must never delete an arbitrary configured production database.

requirements.original_requirement: Create an approximately three-minute rehearsal: PGRC receives a Pune fee-refund case; RB receives a paraphrase using an abbreviation; institution resolution and relationship evidence appear; an unrelated faculty case stays independent; an officer records coordination and next actions; the timeline shows accountability; an isolated demo clock triggers an alert; management exports the permitted institution report. Briefly demonstrate that the Nagpur institution is separate. Keep each claimed capability observable.

requirements.original_requirement: Prepare backup screenshots or a recording from the actual working build, labelled with its capture date/version. Verify all demo links, login credentials, reset commands, and model-cache availability. An official submission template overrides the provisional pitch outline when supplied; do not assume the panel will open external links or watch a long video.

Ask a teammate unfamiliar with the build to explain the problem and next action from each key screen. Record confusion and repair the interface or narration.
